steps.text: 2:10 P.M. \ Clear
Wolumonde, Leithanien. Once a bustling hub of commerce, this nomadic town is now rarely seen by outsiders.
Rathaus

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Schultz Severin Hawthorn, where have you been?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: How are we supposed to get anything done in a strategic planning session without you?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Was I here when you decided my son's fate?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Well... Tatjana should already have...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Yes, she told me. You had her tell me. I'm only reminding you what you've done.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: The Infected are still protesting. They've even started chasing off Infected newcomers.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: What do they want?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: They... they believe the fire was part of some kind of plot. They demand an explanation for Dr. Atro and the dead Infected.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: A plot? An explanation? Great, someone must be riling them up.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Even the Infected wouldn't stoop that low. Most of them are from Wolumonde.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Have they had any contact with that militant group out there?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: None, for now.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: But the militants have been lingering around the outskirts of the hamlet. I'm worried they might influence the protestors.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Just a second, it's from the sentry—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Two? Infected?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: They claim to be from Rhodes Island? I know that name—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: That would be Dr. Atro's company. *Sigh.* We knew this was coming.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Wh-what do we do?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Dr. Atro was a respectable Infected. They may be here looking for her. And they have a right to know the truth.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Let them in.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: ...You heard him. Do as he says.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Hmm, are you sure about this? What if they have something to do with the militants out there?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Between the Great Rift, the fire, and the Infected, do we have the luxury to be suspicious of everyone who knocks on our door?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: What about after they learn the truth? What if Rhodes Island seeks reparations from us? How much is Wolumonde to suffer?!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...So what should we do?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Lock our doors and send them away? Lie to them? Tell them Dr. Atro took some Oripathy patients out on a hike?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: I know we can't sweep it under the rug. But you don't have the final say in this. We have to prepare for the worst.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No one has the final say on the truth, but... Never mind. Do as you will.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'm leaving.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Leaving? Where are you going this time?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...I have a problem to solve.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: My only job is to get this town back on track. The decision-making process? I have little patience for your political games.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Hey! Wait!

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: I know you're suffering, and there's so much we could've done better, but we had no choice!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I understand. That's why I'm still talking to you nice and peacefully.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'll leave Rhodes Island to you. You're good at these things. I'll walk the blocks.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: That's the deal.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Severin! Severin Hawthorn! You are this town's Schultz! You can't be running all over the—

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Ugh! Must he always...

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Forget it. Tatjana, Severin, Thor. They're all tragic figures, really.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Let's get this place cleaned up. Rhodes Island will be here soon.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Wolumonde. Its name means 'The Eighth Moon,' and together with seven other nearby towns, it makes up Leithanien's flourishing northern trade network—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: That's what the book said, anyway.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: From what I'm seeing, 'flourishing trade' isn't exactly how I'd describe it.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Could it be because of the 'Great Rift' thing?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Yes. A Catastrophe of that scale is rare. It could be more than a thousand meters deep, with exposed active Originium on the cliffsides. I shudder just thinking about it.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But, Miss Folinic... You were very curious what would happen if you lobbed a shell into it...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Nay, that was just my academic curiosity speaking. Realistically, one wrong move and the entire plateau could get cleaved in half.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Considering the detour we had to take, looks like this town won't be moving an inch.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Visitors at a time like this? And such strange clothes. I hope this isn't an ill omen...

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Look at her tails. Oh, and the crystals on her shoulder! Is she Infected?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: But those clothes look familiar... Where have I seen them before...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: M-Miss Folinic, can we really just walk down the street like this?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The prevalence of Originium Arts in Leithanien have brought two major benefits: first, the incredible music scene, and second, a broad tolerance of the Infected.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: There may be restrictions on your personal freedom, but should you want to live, you can win back that right as long as you're willing to pay the price.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: ...Price?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: At least it's something affordable.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Wolumonde may be in the boonies and have its fair share of problems, but at least the Infected have a place to live... That's what she told me anyway—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: —Oh, someone's coming.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Hm? That man's uniform...)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Is he with the Wolumonde Gendarmerie? Should we ask for directions?)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (He's coming toward us. Is this the welcoming committee?)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (I'm not sure...)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Oh, he lit a cigarette.)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (He put his lighter into his pocket. Now he's holding the cigarette with his other hand. He switched hands again—)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (—He walked away without looking back! Miss Folinic!)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Excuse me—!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hello, we're—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Ah, Rhodes Island, I take it?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The Rathaus is just up ahead, right in front of the tallest tower. You see it? Good. Someone will meet you there.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Er, thanks. Can I ask your name...?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Me? I'm off duty.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Um, what?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'm off duty. And I really don't want to talk so much when I'm off... I have my own business to deal with.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: That's the deal. Later.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And he's gone?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: He was kind of rude, but I think he's been through a lot...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hah... as if we're not tired!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But at least he told us where to go. Let's go talk to the local—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz! There you are!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: The Infected are protesting again. The Gendarmerie are already on the scene, but they need you there leading them—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Ah! You're smoking! Did the shopkeepers get to you again? Please, you have an image to maintain. You wouldn't want to lose the trust of the people—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Hm? What is it?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: ...That's a... Schultz? A 'Schultheiß' is like a local leader?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Is something wrong, Schultz?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No. You're always working so hard, Tatjana. I admire you.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Do you? Thank you—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Now, about those two, they're not from around here, are they? Could they be the doctors from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Oh? Well, yes. We are indeed. I am Folinic and this is Suzuran.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Doctors?)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (I think we count.)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Even me?)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (I'm a fully-fledged operator assigned to the Medical Department. And Lisa, you've... studied with Dr. Kal'tsit, so we can call you a medical intern. I guess.)

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I see... Oh! You two must be on your way to the Rathaus? I'm so sorry to get in your way!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Of course it should be the Schultz who receives you, but he really is needed at Zwölftontechnik Strasse... Er...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Oh, really, he can—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Ahem! Very good, Tatjana, you take them. I'll go look into this Infected situation.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You two.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: —Yes?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I know why you're here. But our situation is dire.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Do you know what happened to Wolumonde?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The Great Rift.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Yes. I get to skip over so much when dealing with smart people.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: So now the Infected are more riled up than ever before. If you don't want to get mixed up in that, stay away from Zwölftontechnik Strasse.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We are experts at dealing with the Infected.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I know. We had a Dr. Atro from your company working closely with us.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: So you know we can help.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We don't need it yet. It wouldn't be right to drag our guests into this mess as soon as they've arrived. That would get us into trouble too.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...So what is Atro doing here?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: She's not here right now.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: So where is she?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: She...

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Oh no! Fighting has broken out!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Th-those Infected have weapons! What's going on?!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: They've got blades! Are they going to kill us?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You two are Infected experts, yes?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Come with me.
